propositions: Bridge orchestration must be extracted into a runner-neutral packaged Python core and exposed through three public interfaces (Python library, CLI, MCP) and from three install paths (pip wheel, Homebrew, MCP Registry/uvx).

The packaged runner accepts five profiles (reconcile-check, dry-run, bootstrap-strict, bootstrap-throttle, live) and preserves legacy MODE environment variable while using canonical noun profile in public operations.
Direct legacy reconcile callers retain benign results 3/4/75; the new provider runner translates legacy benign results to canonical 0 while preserving operational 1 and invalid-invocation 2.
Successful non-paused delivery passes invoke strict delivery with run id, bot identity, and REBAR_SYNC_PUSH=always; delivery failure returns exit code 1 with diagnostics.
Provider wrapper schema validation and embedded shell linting are performed offline with vendored GitLab Draft-07 schema and pinned ShellCheck version before repository deployment.
No repository-local runner script is shipped; GitHub Actions, Jenkins, and GitLab providers invoke exactly rebar bridge run from the installed package without checkout-time script materialization.
